records.title: Rate-Utility Frontiers for Language Encodings: Comparing Tokens, Bytes, and Pixels Under Controlled Linguistic Content
records.reason: Although language-model encoding and compute budgets are related to inference cost, the authors explicitly state that the models are encoder-based and do not evaluate autoregressive generation. The results therefore do not establish a decoder-only LLM inference/serving efficiency contribution; fit to this survey scope remains weak.

records.title: A Quantum-Classical Hybrid Framework for Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting Complexity-Fidelity Trade-offs and Limitations
records.reason: The work studies quantum-classical time-series forecasting, outside LLM inference/serving scope.

records.title: Towards a Unified Framework for Large–Small Model Collaboration in Cloud–Edge Systems
records.reason: The primary DOI/publisher route was inaccessible for article text in this check. The abstract establishes broad topic relevance but does not identify a concrete evaluated inference-efficiency contribution; no body could be reviewed.

records.title: Generative small language models in clinical NLP: applications, adaptation, and evaluation
records.reason: This is a clinical NLP survey of generative small language models; it does not present a concrete inference/serving efficiency method or evaluation.

records.title: VideoSEMA: a scalable and efficient Mamba-like attention for video understanding
records.reason: VideoSEMA is a video-understanding vision architecture, not an LLM inference/serving contribution.
